quote.text:
A home champion in the capital.
主场冠军，就在这座首都。

And for the American,
对这位美国球员来说，

it is his biggest title since 2022.
这是他自2022年以来最大的一冠。

as he takes down the young Spaniard Rafael Jodar,
他击败了西班牙小将霍达尔，

who pushed him hard in those two sets.
两盘都给他制造了不小的麻烦。
